recentItems.title: Resident Evil x Reddit. Zach Cregger hosted the first ever live in-person Reddit AMA. #ResidentEvil
recentItems.description:
Zach Cregger hosted the first ever live in-person Reddit AMA featuring a screening of the first 30 minutes of the movie in Los Angeles - simulcast in New York and Dallas. 700+ fans. 150+ creators. Three cities. One unforgettable first look at Resident Evil.

From the mind of Zach Cregger, director of Weapons and Barbarian. Filmed for IMAX – Resident Evil is in theatres 9.18. Get tickets now. #ResidentEvil

https://www.instagram.com/residentevil/
https://twitter.com/ResidentEvil
https://www.facebook.com/ResidentEvilMovie
https://www.tiktok.com/@resident.evil.movie

From the mind of visionary filmmaker Zach Cregger (Weapons, Barbarian) comes a thrilling — and terrifying — reinvention of the Resident Evil franchise. In an all-new story, Resident Evil follows Bryan (Austin Abrams), a medical courier who unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
 
From Columbia Pictures and Constantin Film, in association with TriStar Pictures, Resident Evil hits theatres September 18, 2026.

recentItems.title: THE SOCIAL RECKONING – New Trailer (4K)
recentItems.description:
The verdict is in. The reckoning is coming. 
 
The Social Reckoning, a companion piece to The Social Network, is coming exclusively to theatres October 9.


Inspired by true events and the whistleblower who started the social media reckoning we’re seeing play out today, this Aaron Sorkin original screenplay is a companion piece to the hit film The Social Network and a true David and Goliath story. Frances Haugen (Madison), a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz (White), a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network’s most guarded secrets.

recentItems.title: GHOST SOLDIER - Official Trailer | (4K) Starring Jim Caviezel
recentItems.description:
He’s not a threat, he’s a guarantee. Jim Caviezel defends the defenseless in GHOST SOLDIER - coming soon exclusively to movie theatres. #GhostSoldierMovie

In the action-thriller Ghost Soldier, Jim Caviezel stars as Henry “Fitz” Fitzgerald, a solitary man with a mysterious past, living a quiet life off the grid in his hometown. But when a powerful foreign corporation descends on his community determined to seize his and his neighbors’ land for a massive payday, Fitz takes action — he’s actually a former Special Forces soldier and advanced weapons developer. Armed with weapons no one has ever seen, a lifetime of lethal military training, and an unwavering code of justice, Fitz becomes the one thing his enemies never anticipated: a one-man war they can’t win.

recentItems.title: Did they crawl out? #INSIDIOUS: OUT OF THE FURTHER
recentItems.description:
These brave souls took on the very first crawl-through haunted house experience...in the dark. The Further is coming to you - #INSIDIOUS: OUT OF THE FURTHER is exclusively in theatres TOMORROW. Get tickets now.

Follow us on social: 
https://www.instagram.com/InsidiousMovie   
https://twitter.com/InsidiousMovie  
https://www.facebook.com/InsidiousMovie  
https://www.tiktok.com/@insidious.movie

Visit our site: https://insidious.movie 
Subscribe for more exclusive content: https://www.youtube.com/sonypictures 

Having earned over $740 million at the global box office, the Insidious franchise returns with a new family and a terror that redefines what The Further is capable of.
 
In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.
 
With Lin Shaye reprising her iconic role as Elise Rainier and Jacob Chase (Come Play) directing, Insidious: Out of the Further opens August 21, 2026. Screenplay by Jacob Chase. Story by David Leslie Johnson-McGoldrick and Jacob Chase.
